title: Inspect a recorded control operation result by session, operation and idempotency key without claiming replay
outcome: Inspect a recorded control operation result by session, operation and idempotency key without claiming replay
acceptance: A supported read-only inspection returns found/not_found, the operation, its original recorded time, the decision, and an allowlisted refusal code for an exact (target session, turn_begin|turn_checkpoint, idempotency key), in one admitted snapshot
It verifies that the stored intent names the selected grant, bounds payload sizes before decoding, and never returns keys, raw intent or result, or directives
It makes no was_replayed claim; docs state it proves only that a recorded outcome is available for exact replay

completion.summary: A supported read-only inspection returns a recorded control operation's outcome for an exact (session, turn_begin|turn_checkpoint, idempotency key) in one admitted snapshot, verifies the grant binding, bounds payloads, never echoes keys/intents/directives and makes no replay claim. Landed at 1739693f (ancestor of e7426a6) and verified on the Windows B gate bundle test-fdd408e3. An independent acceptance evaluation passed all 3 criteria (record f8d2c8a0b085432ba88be72167a48b88).
